title: Heavy rain and storm disasters designated as extremely severe; Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries raises restoration subsidy rates nationwide
summary: The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries announced on November 27, Reiwa 8, that a government ordinance designating heavy rain and storm disasters, covering the period from May 23 to September 30, Reiwa 8, as an extremely severe disaster was decided at a cabinet meeting. It will raise restoration subsidy rates nationwide and is scheduled to be promulgated and take effect on December 2, Reiwa 8.
source_title: 令和8年5月23日から9月30日までの間の豪雨及び暴風雨による災害についての激甚災害及びこれに対し適用すべき措置の指定に関する政令について

title: Penetapan bencana hujan lebat dan badai sebagai bencana sangat parah; Kementerian Pertanian, Kehutanan dan Perikanan menaikkan rasio bantuan pemulihan di seluruh negeri
summary: Kementerian Pertanian, Kehutanan dan Perikanan pada 27 November Reiwa 8 mengumumkan bahwa peraturan pemerintah yang menetapkan bencana hujan lebat dan badai, dengan periode sasaran dari 23 Mei sampai 30 September Reiwa 8, sebagai bencana sangat parah telah diputuskan dalam rapat kabinet. Rasio bantuan pemulihan akan dinaikkan di seluruh negeri, dan dijadwalkan diundangkan serta diberlakukan pada 2 Desember Reiwa 8.

summary: Bộ Nông nghiệp, Lâm nghiệp và Thủy sản ngày 27 tháng 11 năm Reiwa 8 thông báo rằng nghị định chỉ định thảm họa do mưa lớn và bão, với thời gian áp dụng từ ngày 23 tháng 5 đến ngày 30 tháng 9 năm Reiwa 8, là thảm họa nghiêm trọng đã được quyết định tại cuộc họp Nội các. Tỷ lệ hỗ trợ phục hồi sẽ được tăng trên toàn quốc và dự kiến ban hành, có hiệu lực vào ngày 2 tháng 12 năm Reiwa 8.

title: Indonesia Perluas Upaya Kesiapsiagaan Situs Kunjungan Lintas Provinsi
summary: Otoritas pariwisata Indonesia menyatakan upaya keselamatan situs kunjungan yang sedang berjalan telah menjangkau 1.030 orang di 34 dari 36 provinsi sasaran dan akan berlanjut ke tahun depan. Upaya itu menggabungkan pelatihan yang disesuaikan dengan karakter destinasi, kerja sama dengan Basarnas, nota kesepahaman bertanggal 13 Agustus 2025, serta latihan di sejumlah situs yang disebutkan.

Hoạt động này kết hợp hướng dẫn theo từng loại điểm đến, làm việc chung với Basarnas, một thỏa thuận ngày 13 tháng 8 năm 2025 và các cuộc diễn tập tại các địa điểm được nêu tên.

title: Tokyo to Issue ¥10 Billion in Retail Green and Blue Bonds at 2.330% Annual Interest, Subscription Opens November 24
summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government has set the terms for its retail municipal bond, “Tokyo Green and Blue Bond (yen-denominated).” It is a five-year bond worth ¥10 billion with an annual interest rate of 2.330%; subscriptions will be accepted from November 24 to December 15, 2026, and issuance is scheduled for December 16, 2026.

summary: คณะอนุกรรมการการแลกเปลี่ยนเงินตราต่างประเทศและอื่น ๆ ครั้งที่ 70 ซึ่งอยู่ในความรับผิดชอบของสำนักงานระหว่างประเทศ กระทรวงการคลัง จัดขึ้นเมื่อวันที่ 24 กันยายน 2026 โดยมีวาระเรื่องสถานการณ์การเงินระหว่างประเทศและการรับมือการประเมินระหว่างประเทศครั้งที่ 5 ของ FATF ต่อญี่ปุ่น สำหรับการตรวจประเมินในฤดูร้อนปี 2028 การออกกฎหมายข้อมูลผู้รับผลประโยชน์ที่แท้จริง (BO) ของนิติบุคคลเป็นประเด็นสำคัญ

summary: 재무성 국제국의 제70회 외국환등분과회는 2026년 9월 24일 국제금융 정세와 FATF 제5차 대일 상호심사 대응을 안건으로 삼았다. 2028년 여름 심사를 앞두고 법인의 실질적 지배자 정보 법제화가 초점이 된다.

summary: On November 20, 2026, the Digital Agency announced that it had confirmed the possibility that files in GSS file sharing were accessed by parties other than the intended sharing partners. It confirmed access from July 30 to November 12, Reiwa 8 (2026), suspended the service on November 12, and reported the matter to the Personal Information Protection Commission.

Pihaknya mengonfirmasi adanya akses pada periode 30 Juli hingga 12 November Reiwa 8, menghentikan layanan pada 12 November, dan melaporkannya kepada Komisi Perlindungan Informasi Pribadi.

title: Reiwa 8 staple-food rice crop at 1.359 million ha; MAFF announces planting status as of October 25
summary: On November 20, Reiwa 8, the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) announced the paddy field planting status for the Reiwa 8 crop as of October 25. Staple-food rice stood at 1.359 million ha, down 8,000 ha from the previous year and roughly on par with the Reiwa 7 crop. It updated figures for Chiba, Kumamoto, Okinawa, and the national total.
source_title: 令和8年産の水田における作付状況について

title: Beras untuk konsumsi pokok produksi Tahun Reiwa 8 seluas 1.359.000 ha; Kementerian Pertanian, Kehutanan, dan Perikanan mengumumkan status penanaman per 25 Oktober
summary: Kementerian Pertanian, Kehutanan, dan Perikanan Jepang pada 20 November Tahun Reiwa 8 mengumumkan status penanaman sawah produksi Tahun Reiwa 8 per 25 Oktober. Beras untuk konsumsi pokok seluas 1.359.000 ha, turun 8.000 ha dibanding tahun sebelumnya, setara dengan produksi Tahun Reiwa 7. Nilai untuk Chiba, Kumamoto, dan Okinawa serta nilai nasional diperbarui.
source_title: 令和8年産の水田における作付状況について

title: Diện tích lúa gạo dùng làm lương thực chính niên vụ Reiwa 8 là 1.359.000 ha; Bộ Nông Lâm Thủy sản công bố tình hình gieo trồng tính đến ngày 25/10
summary: Ngày 20/11 năm Reiwa 8, Bộ Nông Lâm Thủy sản công bố tình hình gieo trồng trên ruộng nước niên vụ Reiwa 8 tính đến ngày 25/10. Lúa gạo dùng làm lương thực chính đạt 1.359.000 ha, giảm 8.000 ha so với năm trước, tương đương niên vụ Reiwa 7. Đã cập nhật số liệu của Chiba, Kumamoto, Okinawa và toàn quốc.

title: Classical Swine Fever Case Confirmed at Pig Farm in Nasukarasuyama, Tochigi; Japan's 109th Case as MAFF Holds Disease Prevention and Control Headquarters
summary: According to Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) materials dated November 20, 2026, classical swine fever-infected animals were confirmed at a pig farm in Nasukarasuyama City, Tochigi Prefecture. This is the 109th case in Japan, with about 4,900 pigs raised. The disease prevention and control headquarters was convened by written circulation and outlined measures including culling and epidemiological investigations.

Ini adalah kasus ke-109 di Jepang, dengan sekitar 4.900 ekor babi dipelihara. Rapat Satgas Pengendalian Demam Babi Klasik dan Demam Babi Afrika digelar secara sirkuler, dan arah kebijakan seperti pemusnahan serta investigasi epidemiologi ditetapkan.

title: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries Sets Reiwa 9 Sugarcane Subsidy at ¥16,962 per Ton; Sweet Potatoes for Starch Raw Material at ¥38,420
summary: The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries decided on November 20, Reiwa 8, the producer subsidy unit prices for Reiwa 9 sugarcane and sweet potatoes for starch raw material. Sugarcane is ¥16,962 per ton (up ¥102 from the previous year), and sweet potatoes for starch raw material are ¥38,420 (up ¥2,410).
source_title: 令和9年産さとうきび・でん粉原料用かんしょに係る生産者交付金の単価の決定について

title: Kementerian Pertanian, Kehutanan, dan Perikanan Jepang menetapkan subsidi tebu produksi tahun Reiwa ke-9 sebesar 16.962 yen per ton, ubi jalar bahan baku pati 38.420 yen
summary: Kementerian Pertanian, Kehutanan, dan Perikanan Jepang pada 20 November tahun Reiwa ke-8 menetapkan tarif satuan subsidi produsen untuk tebu dan ubi jalar bahan baku pati produksi tahun Reiwa ke-9. Tebu sebesar 16.962 yen per ton (naik 102 yen dari tahun sebelumnya), ubi jalar bahan baku pati sebesar 38.420 yen (naik 2.410 yen dari tahun sebelumnya).
source_title: 令和9年産さとうきび・でん粉原料用かんしょに係る生産者交付金の単価の決定について

summary: Ngày 20 tháng 11 năm Reiwa 8, Bộ Nông Lâm Thủy sản Nhật Bản đã quyết định đơn giá trợ cấp cho người sản xuất mía và khoai lang nguyên liệu tinh bột niên vụ Reiwa 9. Mía là 16.962 yên/tấn (tăng 102 yên so với năm trước), khoai lang nguyên liệu tinh bột là 38.420 yên (tăng 2.410 yên).

summary: 농림수산성은 레이와 8년 11월 20일, 레이와 9년산 사탕수수와 전분 원료용 고구마의 생산자 교부금 단가를 결정했다. 사탕수수는 1톤당 16,962엔(전년 대비 +102엔), 전분 원료용 고구마는 38,420엔(전년 대비 +2,410엔)이다.

summary: 農林水産省は令和8年11月20日、令和9年産のさとうきびとでん粉原料用かんしょの生産者交付金単価を決めた。さとうきびは1トン16,962円（前年比+102円）、でん粉原料用かんしょは38,420円（同+2,410円）。

title: Osaka City: 9.21 Billion Yen for Salary Revision in FY2026 General Account Supplementary Budget Draft (4th)
summary: Osaka City will add 9.21 billion yen for salary revisions following Personnel Commission recommendations in its FY2026 general account supplementary budget draft (4th). Monthly salaries will close a 3.00% public-private gap, and special allowances will be raised by 0.05 month.
source_title: 「令和8年度一般会計補正予算（第4回）」案
author: Jenny

title: Kota Osaka, 9,21 miliar yen untuk revisi gaji dalam Rancangan Anggaran Umum (Revisi Keempat) TA Reiwa 8
summary: Kota Osaka menambahkan 9,21 miliar yen untuk revisi gaji yang menyertai rekomendasi Komisi Personel dalam Rancangan Anggaran Umum (Revisi Keempat) TA Reiwa 8. Gaji bulanan dinaikkan untuk menutup selisih 3,00 persen antara sektor publik dan swasta, sedangkan tunjangan khusus dinaikkan 0,05 bulan.
source_title: 「令和8年度一般会計補正予算（第4回）」案
author: Jenny

title: Thành phố Osaka: 9 tỷ 210 triệu yên cho điều chỉnh tiền lương, dự thảo ngân sách bổ sung tài khoản tổng hợp lần thứ 4 năm tài chính Reiwa 8
summary: Thành phố Osaka sẽ bổ sung 9 tỷ 210 triệu yên cho phần điều chỉnh tiền lương theo khuyến nghị của Ủy ban Nhân sự trong dự thảo ngân sách bổ sung tài khoản tổng hợp năm tài chính Reiwa 8 (lần thứ 4). Lương hàng tháng sẽ khắc phục mức chênh lệch 3,00% giữa khu vực công và tư, còn phụ cấp đặc biệt tăng 0,05 tháng.
source_title: 「令和8年度一般会計補正予算（第4回）」案
author: Jenny

title: เทศบาลนครโอซากะ ปรับเงินเดือน 9,210 ล้านเยน ร่างงบประมาณเพิ่มเติมจากงบประมาณทั่วไป ปีงบประมาณเรวะ 8 ครั้งที่ 4
summary: เทศบาลนครโอซากะจะเพิ่มเงิน 9,210 ล้านเยนสำหรับการปรับเงินเดือนตามคำแนะนำของคณะกรรมการด้านบุคลากร ในร่างงบประมาณเพิ่มเติมจากงบประมาณทั่วไป ปีงบประมาณเรวะ 8 (ครั้งที่ 4) เงินเดือนประจำจะปรับขึ้นตารางเงินเดือนเพื่อขจัดช่องว่างระหว่างภาครัฐและเอกชนที่ 3.00 เปอร์เซ็นต์ ส่วนเงินพิเศษจะเพิ่มขึ้น 0.05 เดือน

title: 오사카시, 급여 개정에 92억 1,000만 엔 레이와 8년도 일반회계 보정예산 제4차안
summary: 오사카시는 레이와 8년도 일반회계 보정예산(제4차)안에 인사위원회 권고에 따른 급여 개정분 92억 1,000만 엔을 추가한다. 월례급은 공무원과 민간 간 격차 3.00퍼센트를 해소하고, 특별급여는 0.05개월분을 인상한다.
source_title: 「令和8年度一般会計補正予算（第4回）」案

title: 大阪市、給与改定に92億1,000万円 令和8年度一般会計補正予算第4回案
summary: 大阪市は令和8年度一般会計補正予算（第4回）案で、人事委員会勧告に伴う給与改定分92億1,000万円を追加する。月例給は公民較差3.00パーセントを解消し、特別給は0.05月分引き上げる。
source_title: 「令和8年度一般会計補正予算（第4回）」案

title: Osaka City to Collect Small Rechargeable Batteries at 25 Fire Station Counters, Including Main Stations, from December 1, Reiwa 8
summary: Osaka City will begin collecting small rechargeable batteries and mobile batteries at counters at main stations and the Water Fire Station among the city’s 25 fire stations from December 1, Reiwa 8. The service is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and only items generated by households in the city are eligible.
source_title: 市内の25消防署でリチウムイオン電池等の回収を開始します！
author: Eric

title: Kota Osaka akan mengumpulkan baterai isi ulang kecil di loket 25 kantor pemadam kebakaran, termasuk kantor pusat, mulai 1 Desember tahun Reiwa ke-8
summary: Kota Osaka akan mulai mengumpulkan baterai isi ulang kecil dan power bank di loket 25 kantor pemadam kebakaran di dalam kota, yaitu kantor pusat dan Kantor Pemadam Kebakaran Perairan, mulai 1 Desember tahun Reiwa ke-8. Layanan ini dapat digunakan 24 jam sehari, 365 hari setahun, dan hanya menerima barang yang berasal dari rumah tangga di dalam kota.
source_title: 市内の25消防署でリチウムイオン電池等の回収を開始します！

title: Thành phố Osaka sẽ thu gom pin sạc cỡ nhỏ tại quầy của 25 sở cứu hỏa, gồm cả trụ sở chính, từ ngày 1 tháng 12 năm Reiwa thứ 8
summary: Thành phố Osaka sẽ bắt đầu thu gom pin sạc cỡ nhỏ, pin dự phòng và các loại tương tự tại quầy của trụ sở chính thuộc 25 sở cứu hỏa trong thành phố và Sở Cứu hỏa trên mặt nước từ ngày 1 tháng 12 năm Reiwa thứ 8. Hoạt động tiếp nhận 24 giờ/ngày, 365 ngày/năm; đối tượng chỉ giới hạn ở các sản phẩm phát sinh từ hộ gia đình trong thành phố.
source_title: 市内の25消防署でリチウムイオン電池等の回収を開始します！

summary: นครโอซากะจะเริ่มรับคืนแบตเตอรี่แบบชาร์จไฟได้ขนาดเล็กและพาวเวอร์แบงก์ ฯลฯ ที่เคาน์เตอร์สถานีดับเพลิง 25 แห่งในเมือง ซึ่งรวมถึงสถานีหลักและสถานีดับเพลิงซุยโจ (水上消防署) ตั้งแต่วันที่ 1 ธันวาคม ปีเรวะที่ 8 โดยใช้ได้ตลอด 24 ชั่วโมง 365 วัน และรับเฉพาะสิ่งของจากครัวเรือนในเมืองเท่านั้น

title: 오사카시, 본서 등 25개 소방서 창구에서 레이와 8년 12월 1일부터 소형 충전식 배터리 회수
summary: 오사카시는 레이와 8년 12월 1일부터 시내 25개 소방서의 본서와 수상소방서 창구에서 소형 충전식 배터리와 모바일 배터리 등을 회수하기 시작한다. 24시간 365일 이용할 수 있으며, 대상은 시내 가정에서 나온 것에 한한다.
source_title: 市内の25消防署でリチウムイオン電池等の回収を開始します！

title: 大阪市、本署など25消防署の窓口で令和8年12月1日から小型充電式電池を回収へ
summary: 大阪市は令和8年12月1日から、市内25消防署の本署と水上消防署の窓口で小型充電式電池やモバイルバッテリーなどの回収を始める。24時間365日利用でき、対象は市内の家庭から出たものに限る。

title: Osaka City's Naniwa Ward: My Number Card-related procedures unavailable at November 22 Sunday opening
summary: Osaka City's Naniwa Ward says that at its Sunday opening on November 22 (Sunday), all related procedures, including receiving a My Number Card and renewing electronic certificates, will be unavailable due to system maintenance.

author: Eric

title: Distrik Naniwa, Kota Osaka: Prosedur Terkait Kartu My Number Tidak Tersedia pada Pembukaan Kantor Hari Minggu 22 November
summary: Distrik Naniwa, Kota Osaka, menyatakan bahwa pada hari pembukaan kantor hari Minggu, 22 November (Minggu), semua prosedur terkait Kartu My Number, seperti penerimaan kartu dan pembaruan sertifikat elektronik, tidak dapat dilakukan karena pemeliharaan sistem.
source_title: 11月の日曜開庁日はマイナンバー関連の手続きができません

title: Quận Naniwa, thành phố Osaka: Không thể thực hiện các thủ tục liên quan đến thẻ My Number trong ngày mở cửa Chủ nhật 22 tháng 11
summary: Quận Naniwa, thành phố Osaka cho biết, vào ngày mở cửa Chủ nhật 22 tháng 11 (Chủ nhật), do bảo trì hệ thống, tất cả các thủ tục liên quan như nhận thẻ My Number và gia hạn chứng thư điện tử sẽ không thể thực hiện.
source_title: 11月の日曜開庁日はマイナンバー関連の手続きができません

title: เขตนวนิวะ นครโอซากะ ไม่สามารถให้บริการขั้นตอนที่เกี่ยวข้องกับบัตรマイナンバーได้ในการเปิดทำการวันอาทิตย์วันที่ 22 พฤศจิกายน
summary: เขตนวนิวะ นครโอซากะ ระบุว่า สำหรับวันเปิดทำการวันอาทิตย์วันที่ 22 พฤศจิกายน (วันอาทิตย์) เนื่องจากการบำรุงรักษาระบบ จะไม่สามารถดำเนินการขั้นตอนที่เกี่ยวข้องกับบัตรマイナンバーได้ทั้งหมด รวมถึงการรับบัตรและการต่ออายุใบรับรองอิเล็กทรอนิกส์
source_title: 11月の日曜開庁日はマイナンバー関連の手続きができません

summary: On November 3, Reiwa 8, the Osaka City Fire Department held a fire prevention works award ceremony and an autumn fire prevention campaign event, and three elementary school students in Suminoe Ward received Excellence Awards in the "Fire Prevention and Disaster Prevention Drawing" category. Koharu Kashiwagi of Anritsu Elementary School had her work selected as the model drawing for the Reiwa 9 spring fire prevention poster and served as one-day fire station chief after the ceremony.

title: 3 Siswa SD di Suminoe-ku Raih Penghargaan Unggulan dalam Gambar Pencegahan Kebakaran dan Bencana; Kashiwagi Koharu dari SD Anryu Menjadi Gambar Model Poster Musim Semi Reiwa 9
summary: Pada 3 November Reiwa 8, di Dinas Pemadam Kebakaran Kota Osaka digelar upacara penghargaan karya pencegahan kebakaran dan acara pembukaan kampanye pencegahan kebakaran musim gugur. Tiga siswa SD di wilayah Suminoe-ku meraih penghargaan unggulan dalam Bagian Gambar Pencegahan Kebakaran dan Bencana. Kashiwagi Koharu dari SD Anryu menjadi gambar model poster pencegahan kebakaran musim semi Reiwa 9, dan setelah upacara ia bertugas sebagai kepala kantor pemadam kebakaran selama satu hari.

title: 3 học sinh tiểu học ở Suminoe-ku đoạt giải xuất sắc tại hạng mục tranh phòng cháy, phòng chống thiên tai; em Kashiwagi Miharu, Trường Tiểu học Anryu, được chọn làm tranh mẫu cho poster mùa xuân năm Re
summary: Ngày 3 tháng 11 năm Reiwa 8, lễ trao giải các tác phẩm phòng cháy và sự kiện khai mạc Chiến dịch phòng cháy mùa thu đã diễn ra tại Sở Cứu hỏa Thành phố Osaka; 3 học sinh tiểu học trong quận Suminoe đoạt giải xuất sắc ở hạng mục tranh vẽ phòng cháy, phòng chống thiên tai. The planned borrowing amount is about 1.2 trillion yen; the borrowing date is December 3, Reiwa 8, and the redemption date is June 2, Reiwa 9.

Perkiraan jumlah pinjaman sekitar 1,2 triliun yen; tanggal pinjaman 3 Desember Reiwa 8, jatuh tempo 2 Juni Reiwa 9.

title: Hiroshima City provides information on evening classes, with weekday evening lessons at Futaba and Kannon junior high schools for citizens aged 15 and over
summary: In guidance updated on November 19, 2026, Hiroshima City introduces evening classes for citizens aged 15 and over who were unable to receive sufficient compulsory education. Classes are held on weekday evenings at Futaba Junior High School and Kannon Junior High School, and completion confers a junior high school graduation qualification.

Kelas diadakan pada malam hari kerja di SMP Futaba dan SMP Kannon, dan mereka yang menyelesaikan program dapat memperoleh kualifikasi kelulusan SMP.

The signing ceremony is scheduled to be held from 15:00 on November 25 on the 10th floor of the City Hall Main Building.

(広島アグリフードサービス株式会社) mengenai pengadaan makanan bersuhu sesuai dan pasokannya ke tempat pengungsian saat bencana. title: Tokyo Environmental Impact Assessment Council to Hold 8th General Meeting on Nov. 27; Report on Kabukicho Heliport Plan Among Agenda Items
summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Environment announced that it will hold the eighth general meeting of the Tokyo Metropolitan Environmental Impact Assessment Council for fiscal 2026 (Reiwa 8) from 10:00 a.m. on November 27, 2026, in a combined in-person and online format. The agenda includes a report on the Kabukicho heliport plan, among other items, and observer applications are due by November 25.

Agenda mencakup tanggapan resmi atas rencana Heliport Kabukicho, dengan pendaftaran penonton sidang paling lambat 25 November.

summary: Midosuji Runway 2026 will be held on November 23, 2026 (Reiwa 8), from 14:00 to 16:00 on Midosuji. Traffic restrictions will begin around 11:30.

Pembatasan lalu lintas mulai sekitar pukul 11.30.

title: Email delivery records for 320 addresses leaked at Tokyo rental housing owner support site

Dari jumlah itu, 148 di antaranya berpotensi mengidentifikasi individu.

summary: 財務省が公開した資料では、交付税及び譲与税配付金特別会計の借入金について、令和8年11月17日入札分の募入決定額を1兆1,999億9,900万円、募入平均利率を1.588％と記載している。

title: Four Funds Cited as Having About 230 Billion Yen in Return Potential; Finance Minister Katayama Mentions Coordination Between Fund Review and Special Tax Measure Debate
summary: At a post-Cabinet meeting press conference on November 17, Reiwa 8, Finance Minister Katayama, noting that the Administrative Program Review pointed out about 230 billion yen in room for return to the national treasury across four funds, indicated his intention to work in coordination on the review of funds under the Japan-style DOGE and on optimizing special tax measures.
source_title: 片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要(令和8年11月17日(火曜日))

title: 4 Dana Disebut Berpeluang Mengembalikan Sekitar 230 Miliar Yen ke Kas Negara; Menteri Keuangan Katayama Menyinggung Keterkaitan Peninjauan Dana dan Pembahasan Tindakan Pajak Khusus
summary: Menteri Keuangan Katayama dalam konferensi pers setelah rapat kabinet pada 17 November Reiwa 8 menyatakan, menindaklanjuti temuan tinjauan program administrasi bahwa 4 dana memiliki ruang pengembalian ke kas negara sekitar 230 miliar yen, ia akan bekerja secara terpadu dalam peninjauan dana DOGE versi Jepang dan optimalisasi tindakan pajak khusus.
source_title: 片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要(令和8年11月17日(火曜日))
author: Kevin

title: Chỉ ra dư địa hoàn trả khoảng 230 tỷ yên ở 4 quỹ; Bộ trưởng Tài chính Katayama đề cập sự phối hợp giữa rà soát quỹ và thảo luận ưu đãi thuế đặc biệt
summary: Bộ trưởng Tài chính Katayama, tại cuộc họp báo sau phiên họp Nội các ngày 17 tháng 11 năm Reiwa 8, đã cho biết ý định phối hợp thúc đẩy rà soát quỹ của DOGE phiên bản Nhật Bản và hợp lý hóa các biện pháp ưu đãi thuế đặc biệt, trên cơ sở việc rà soát chương trình hành chính chỉ ra dư địa hoàn trả khoảng 230 tỷ yên cho ngân sách nhà nước ở 4 quỹ.
source_title: 片山財務大臣兼内閣府特命担当大臣閣議後記者会見の概要(令和8年11月17日(火曜日))

summary: 片山財務大臣は令和8年11月17日の閣議後会見で、行政事業レビューで4基金に約2,300億円の国庫返納余地が指摘されたことを踏まえ、日本版DOGEの基金見直しや租税特別措置の適正化に連携して取り組む考えを示した。

title: Low-fare truck operators need about 30% cost increase; plan through 2030 presented at transport minister's briefing
summary: At the Nov. 17, 2026 press conference of Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism Ibayashi, estimates showed that truck operators for which low-fare transactions have become the norm need an approximately 30% cost increase, and a phased increase plan through June 2030 was presented.
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Michelle

title: Truk bertarif rendah perlu kenaikan biaya pokok sekitar 30%; rancangan aturan hingga 2030 dalam konferensi pers Menteri Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, Transportasi dan Pariwisata
summary: Dalam konferensi pers Menteri Pertanahan, Infrastruktur, Transportasi dan Pariwisata 井林辰憲 pada 17 November 2026, disampaikan estimasi bahwa operator truk yang transaksi tarif rendahnya telah menjadi hal biasa memerlukan kenaikan biaya pokok sekitar 30%, serta rancangan kenaikan bertahap hingga Juni 2030.
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Michelle

title: Xe tải cước thấp cần tăng khoảng 30% giá thành; phương án thể chế đến năm 2030 tại cuộc họp báo của Bộ trưởng Đất đai, Hạ tầng, Giao thông và Du lịch
summary: Ngày 17/11/2026, tại cuộc họp báo của Bộ trưởng Đất đai, Hạ tầng, Giao thông và Du lịch Ibayashi Tatsunori (井林辰憲), ước tính rằng các doanh nghiệp vận tải xe tải có tình trạng giao dịch cước thấp trở thành thường xuyên cần tăng khoảng 30% giá thành, cùng phương án tăng dần đến tháng 6/2030, đã được trình bày.
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Michelle

title: รถบรรทุกที่ค่าขนส่งต่ำต้องเพิ่มต้นทุนราว 30% แผนระบบถึงปี 2030 ในการแถลงข่าวรัฐมนตรีว่าการกระทรวงที่ดินฯ
summary: ในงานแถลงข่าวของรัฐมนตรีว่าการกระทรวงที่ดิน โครงสร้างพื้นฐาน การขนส่ง และการท่องเที่ยว อิบายาชิ เมื่อวันที่ 17 พฤศจิกายน 2026 มีการเสนอประมาณการว่าผู้ประกอบการรถบรรทุกที่การซื้อขายค่าขนส่งต่ำกลายเป็นปกติจำเป็นต้องเพิ่มต้นทุนประมาณ 30% และแผนปรับขึ้นเป็นขั้นบันไดจนถึงเดือนมิถุนายน 2030
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨

title: 저운임 트럭은 약 30% 원가 상승 필요… 국토교통대신 기자회견서 2030년까지 제도안
summary: 2026년 11월 17일 이바야시 국토교통대신 기자회견에서 저운임 거래가 상시화된 트럭 사업자는 약 30%의 원가 상승이 필요하다는 추산과 2030년 6월까지의 단계적 인상안이 제시됐다.

title: 低運賃トラックは約3割の原価上昇必要 国交相会見で2030年までの制度案
summary: 2026年11月17日の井林国土交通大臣会見で、低運賃取引が常態化するトラック事業者は約3割の原価上昇が必要との試算と、2030年6月までの段階的引上げ案が示された。
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Michelle

title: Minister Ibayashi Calls on Consumers to Adjust How They Receive Deliveries for Year-End Logistics; Also Mentions Tamahome Reports and Metropolitan Expressway Tolls
summary: At a press conference on November 13, 2026, Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism Ibayashi, anticipating increased year-end logistics demand, called for outreach to businesses and for consumers to devise ways to receive deliveries. He also mentioned reports concerning Tamahome, the Metropolitan Expressway toll revision, and park development in Chofu.
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Eric

title: Menteri Ibayashi Serukan Konsumen Menyesuaikan Cara Menerima Paket untuk Logistik Akhir Tahun, Menyinggung Pemberitaan Tamahome dan Tarif Jalan Tol Metropolitan
summary: Menteri Ibayashi dalam konferensi pers 13 November 2026, dengan memperhatikan peningkatan logistik akhir tahun, menyerukan pelaku usaha dan meminta konsumen menyesuaikan cara menerima paket. Ia juga menyinggung pemberitaan Tamahome, penyesuaian tarif Jalan Tol Metropolitan, dan pembangunan taman di Chofu.
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Eric

title: Bộ trưởng Đất đai, Hạ tầng, Giao thông và Du lịch Ibayashi kêu gọi người tiêu dùng linh hoạt cách nhận hàng trong logistics cuối năm; đề cập thông tin về Tamahome và phí cao tốc đô thị
summary: Bộ trưởng Đất đai, Hạ tầng, Giao thông và Du lịch Ibayashi, tại cuộc họp báo ngày 13 tháng 11 năm 2026, đã kêu gọi các doanh nghiệp có biện pháp ứng phó và người tiêu dùng linh hoạt trong cách nhận hàng, nhằm đối phó với sự gia tăng logistics cuối năm. Ông cũng đề cập thông tin đưa tin về Tamahome, việc điều chỉnh phí đường cao tốc đô thị thủ đô và việc xây dựng công viên tại Chofu.
source_title: 井林大臣会見要旨
author: Eric

title: รมว.อิบายาชิเรียกร้องผู้บริโภคปรับวิธีรับสินค้าในช่วงโลจิสติกส์ปลายปี พร้อมกล่าวถึงข่าวทามาโฮมและค่าผ่านทางทางด่วนโตเกียว
summary: รมว.อิบายาชิกล่าวในการแถลงข่าวเมื่อวันที่ 13 พฤศจิกายน 2026 ว่า โดยคำนึงถึงปริมาณโลจิสติกส์ที่เพิ่มขึ้นช่วงปลายปี ได้เรียกร้องให้ผู้ประกอบการดำเนินการและให้ผู้บริโภคปรับวิธีรับสินค้า พร้อมกล่าวถึงข่าวทามาโฮม การปรับค่าผ่านทางทางด่วนโตเกียว และการพัฒนาสวนสาธารณะในโชฟุ

summary: 이바야시 국토교통상은 2026년 11월 13일 기자회견에서 연말 물류 증가를 내다보고 사업자에 대한 촉구와 소비자의 수령 방식 고안을 호소했다. 타마홈 보도, 수도고속도로 요금 개정, 조후 공원 정비에 대해서도 언급했다.

title: 井林国交相、年末物流で消費者に受け取り工夫を呼びかけ タマホーム報道や首都高料金にも言及

title: Public recruitment begins for President of the Food and Agricultural Materials Inspection Center; applications accepted until December 14
summary: On November 17, 2026, the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries began public recruitment for the position of President of the independent administrative agency Food and Agricultural Materials Inspection Center. The application period runs until December 14.

Pemeriksaan ini mencakup pengawasan dua sisi terhadap BHA, BHT, dan PG yang diizinkan di Jepang serta TBHQ dan jenis lain yang tidak diizinkan.

Gói thầu đảm nhận quản lý tiến độ, chi phí, ứng phó rủi ro và điều phối với các cơ quan liên quan cho toàn bộ dự án, hướng tới hoàn thành vào cuối năm tài khóa Reiwa 14.
source_title: 建設局公募型プロポーザル方式発注案件（令和8年度 淀川左岸線（2期）事業外1CM（コンストラクション・マネジメント）業務委託）
author: Jenny

title: สำนักการก่อสร้างเทศบาลนครโอซากะ เปิดรับข้อเสนอแบบเปิด (公募型プロポーザル) สำหรับงาน CM โครงการถนนฝั่งซ้ายแม่น้ำโยโดะ ระยะที่ 2 มุ่งสู่การแล้วเสร็จภายในสิ้นปีงบประมาณเรวะ 14
summary: สำนักการก่อสร้างเทศบาลนครโอซากะ ระบุงานจ้างบริหารการก่อสร้าง (CM) โครงการถนนฝั่งซ้ายแม่น้ำโยโดะ ระยะที่ 2 และอื่น ๆ ประจำปีงบประมาณเรวะ 8 เป็นโครงการจัดซื้อจัดจ้างด้วยวิธีการเปิดรับข้อเสนอ (公募型プロポーザル) โดยรับผิดชอบการบริหารกำหนดการและค่าใช้จ่ายของโครงการโดยรวม การรับมือความเสี่ยง และการประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง มุ่งเป้าแล้วเสร็จภายในสิ้นปีงบประมาณเรวะ 14

summary: 오사카시 건설국은 레이와 8년도 요도가와 좌안선(2기) 사업 외 1 CM 업무 위탁을 공모형 프로포절 방식의 발주 건으로 제시했다. 사업 전체의 공정·비용 관리와 리스크 대응, 관계기관 조정을 맡고 레이와 14년도 말 완성을 목표로 한다.

title: 大阪市建設局、淀川左岸線2期のCM業務で公募型プロポーザル 令和14年度末完成へ

title: Osaka City Seeks Participants for Shanghai Buyers' Business Meeting 2026; Event Set for December 15 with About 15 Osaka-Based Companies
summary: Osaka City plans to hold the China-Shanghai Buyers' Business Meeting 2026 on December 15, 2026. The event will offer opportunities for direct business talks with buyer companies from Shanghai. The city will recruit about 15 companies and organizations with bases in Osaka Prefecture, and the application deadline is December 9.

title: Kota Osaka Membuka Pendaftaran Perusahaan Peserta Pertemuan Bisnis dengan Pembeli Shanghai 2026, Digelar 15 Desember, Sekitar 15 Perusahaan Berbasis di Prefektur Osaka
summary: Kota Osaka berencana menggelar “Pertemuan Bisnis dengan Pembeli Shanghai, Tiongkok 2026” pada 15 Desember Reiwa 8. Ini merupakan kesempatan untuk melakukan pertemuan bisnis langsung dengan perusahaan pembeli dari Shanghai; sekitar 15 perusahaan/organisasi yang memiliki basis di Prefektur Osaka akan direkrut, dan batas akhir pendaftaran adalah 9 Desember.

title: Thành phố Osaka tuyển doanh nghiệp tham gia Hội nghị giao thương với người mua Thượng Hải 2026, tổ chức ngày 15/12, khoảng 15 doanh nghiệp có cơ sở tại tỉnh Osaka
summary: Thành phố Osaka dự kiến tổ chức Hội nghị giao thương với người mua Trung Quốc - Thượng Hải 2026 vào ngày 15 tháng 12 năm 2026. Đây là cơ hội đàm phán trực tiếp với các doanh nghiệp mua hàng tại Thượng Hải; thành phố tuyển khoảng 15 doanh nghiệp, tổ chức có cơ sở tại tỉnh Osaka, hạn đăng ký là ngày 9 tháng 12.

summary: 오사카시는 레이와 8년(2026년) 12월 15일 '중국·상하이 바이어 상담회 2026'을 개최할 예정이다. 상하이의 바이어 기업과 직접 상담할 수 있는 기회로, 오사카부 내에 거점을 둔 기업·단체 등을 15개사 정도 모집하며 신청 마감은 12월 9일이다.

title: 大阪市、上海バイヤー商談会2026の参加企業募集 12月15日開催、府内拠点企業15社程度
summary: 大阪市は令和8年12月15日に「中国・上海バイヤー商談会2026」を開催予定。上海のバイヤー企業と直接商談できる機会で、大阪府内の拠点を持つ企業・団体等を15社程度募集し、申込締切は12月9日。

title: Osaka City's 'Nagomi' Parent Salon: 13th Session for Parents Only, 14th Session Features Light Sports for Parents and Children
summary: The Osaka City Board of Education's School Attendance Support Room 'Nagomi' will hold its 13th and 14th 'Parent Salon' sessions for parents of children who are not attending school. The 13th session is limited to parents, while the 14th is planned as light sports for parents and children; applications are via the two-dimensional code on the flyer.
source_title: 登校支援室「なごみ」 保護者サロンの実施について

title: Salon Orang Tua 'Nagomi' Kota Osaka: Edisi ke-13 Khusus Orang Tua, Edisi ke-14 Olahraga Ringan Bersama Anak
summary: Ruang Dukungan Kehadiran Sekolah 'Nagomi' Dewan Pendidikan Kota Osaka mengadakan 'Salon Orang Tua' edisi ke-13 dan ke-14 bagi orang tua yang memiliki anak tidak bersekolah. Edisi ke-13 khusus orang tua, edisi ke-14 direncanakan olahraga ringan bersama anak; pendaftaran melalui kode dua dimensi pada selebaran.
source_title: 登校支援室「なごみ」 保護者サロンの実施について

title: Salon phụ huynh của “Nagomi” thành phố Osaka: lần thứ 13 chỉ dành cho phụ huynh, lần thứ 14 phụ huynh và con cùng chơi thể thao nhẹ
summary: Phòng Hỗ trợ đến trường “Nagomi” thuộc Ủy ban Giáo dục thành phố Osaka tổ chức “Salon Phụ huynh” lần thứ 13 và 14 dành cho phụ huynh có con không đến trường. Lần thứ 13 chỉ dành cho phụ huynh, lần thứ 14 dự kiến phụ huynh và con cùng chơi thể thao nhẹ; đăng ký qua mã hai chiều trên tờ rơi.

title: ซาลอนสำหรับผู้ปกครองของ 'นาโกมิ' (なごみ) เมืองโอซากะ ครั้งที่ 13 จำกัดเฉพาะผู้ปกครอง ครั้งที่ 14 เป็นกีฬาเบา ๆ สำหรับผู้ปกครองและบุตร
summary: ห้องสนับสนุนการไปโรงเรียน 'นาโกมิ' (なごみ) ของคณะกรรมการการศึกษาเมืองโอซากะ จัด 'ซาลอนสำหรับผู้ปกครอง' ครั้งที่ 13 และครั้งที่ 14 สำหรับผู้ปกครองที่มีบุตรไม่ไปโรงเรียน โดยครั้งที่ 13 จำกัดเฉพาะผู้ปกครอง ครั้งที่ 14 กำหนดจัดกีฬาเบา ๆ สำหรับผู้ปกครองและบุตร สมัครผ่านคิวอาร์โค้ดบนใบปลิว

title: 오사카시 「나고미」 보호자 살롱, 제13회는 보호자 한정·제14회는 부모와 자녀가 함께하는 가벼운 스포츠
summary: 오사카시 교육위원회의 등교 지원실 「나고미」가 등교를 거부하는 자녀를 둔 보호자를 대상으로 제13·14회 「보호자 살롱」을 개최한다. 제13회는 보호자 한정, 제14회는 부모와 자녀가 함께하는 가벼운 스포츠를 예정하며, 신청은 안내 전단의 2차원 코드에서 한다.
source_title: 登校支援室「なごみ」 保護者サロンの実施について

title: 大阪市「なごみ」の保護者サロン、第13回は保護者限定・第14回は親子で軽スポーツ
summary: 大阪市教育委員会の登校支援室「なごみ」が、不登校の子を持つ保護者向けに第13・14回「保護者サロン」を開催。第13回は保護者限定、第14回は親子で軽スポーツを予定し、申込はチラシの2次元コードから。

title: Osaka City announces partnership agreement with NEC Corporation on nursing care prevention, with signing date of November 13, Reiwa 8
summary: Osaka City announced a partnership agreement with NEC Corporation on the promotion of nursing care prevention and related measures, with the signing date set for Friday, November 13, Reiwa 8. The two parties aim to leverage their resources to extend citizens' healthy life expectancy and co-create a model for regional revitalization.
source_title: 大阪市は日本電気株式会社と介護予防等の推進に関する連携協定を締結しました

title: Pemerintah Kota Osaka Umumkan Perjanjian Kerja Sama Pencegahan Kebutuhan Perawatan dengan NEC Corporation, Tanggal Penandatanganan 13 November 2026 (Reiwa 8)
summary: Pemerintah Kota Osaka mengumumkan perjanjian kerja sama dengan NEC Corporation mengenai promosi pencegahan kebutuhan perawatan dan sejenisnya, dengan tanggal penandatanganan 13 November 2026 (Reiwa 8). Kedua pihak akan memanfaatkan sumber daya masing-masing dan menargetkan perpanjangan harapan hidup sehat warga serta penciptaan bersama model pengembangan kawasan.

title: Osaka công bố thỏa thuận hợp tác phòng ngừa nhu cầu chăm sóc điều dưỡng với NEC (日本電気株式会社), lấy ngày 13 tháng 11 năm Reiwa 8 làm ngày ký kết
summary: Thành phố Osaka đã công bố thỏa thuận hợp tác với NEC (日本電気株式会社) về thúc đẩy phòng ngừa nhu cầu chăm sóc điều dưỡng, lấy ngày 13 tháng 11 năm Reiwa 8 làm ngày ký kết. Hai bên tận dụng nguồn lực, hướng tới kéo dài tuổi thọ khỏe mạnh của người dân và đồng sáng tạo mô hình kích hoạt địa phương.

summary: 大阪市は、日本電気株式会社との介護予防等の推進に関する連携協定について、令和8年11月13日を締結日として公表した。両者は資源を生かし、市民の健康寿命延伸や地域活性化モデルの共創をめざす。

title: Osaka City to accept first-come applications for remaining plots at Uriwari, Hattori and Minami Cemeteries; applications start November 17, use fees from 800,000 yen
summary: Osaka City will accept applications for cemetery plot users on a first-come, first-served basis from November 17, Reiwa 8, to March 7, Reiwa 9, targeting plots left over from the lottery application at Uriwari, Hattori and Minami Cemeteries. Use fees start at 800,000 yen.

summary: Pemerintah Kota Osaka akan menerima pendaftaran pengguna petak pemakaman dengan sistem siapa cepat dia dapat mulai 17 November Reiwa 8 hingga 7 Maret Reiwa 9, untuk antara lain petak yang tersisa dari pendaftaran undian di Taman Makam Uriwari, Hattori, dan Minami. Biaya penggunaan mulai 800.000 yen.

title: 삿포로시, 등유 평균 163.12엔 11월 10일 조사 결과 일부 정정
summary: 삿포로시는 2026년 11월 16일 석유제품 소매가격 조사의 최신 결과를 갱신했다. 11월 10일 조사의 등유 평균 가격은 1리터당 163.12엔으로 전회 대비 +3.77엔이었다. 시는 결과 일부를 적색으로 정정했다고 밝혔다.
source_title: 石油製品小売価格調査結果を一部訂正しました。
author: Vivian

title: 札幌市、灯油平均163.12円 11月10日調査結果を一部訂正
summary: 札幌市は2026年11月16日、石油製品小売価格調査の最新結果を更新した。11月10日調査の灯油平均価格は1リットル当たり163.12円、前回比＋3.77円。市は結果の一部を赤字で訂正したとしている。
source_title: 石油製品小売価格調査結果を一部訂正しました。
